thread:
maya: quick a11y sweep on the new deployment drawer. a few notes: focus ring low contrast in dark, keyboard arrows not cycling, and screen reader reads each item as 'link' instead of 'option'.

devon: can you repro steps? which drawer state?

maya: open drawer > tab to model selector list > try arrow keys. repro on latest canary and in dark theme at 125% zoom.

sophie: likely semantics + CSS. if items are buttons/links we should change to role="option" inside a listbox or use role="radio" depending on UX. also increase outline thickness for dark.

eli: product question: should this selector behave like a listbox (type-ahead?) or simple radio? we have ~5 models only.

maya: radio is fine. five items, mutually exclusive. support arrows and Home/End.

devon: patch plan: add role="radiogroup" wrapper, role="radio" items, aria-checked toggles, manage tabindex. CSS: outline: 2px solid var(--bg-cta-yellow); outline-offset: 3px.

sophie: add keyboard handlers: left/right to move, Enter/Space to select, Home/End to jump. update aria-live polite announcer: 

maya: example announcer copy: "Model switched to X; est. latency ~150 ms." round to nearest 50ms.

devon: ok. question: should announcer include latency for privacy/regression reasons?

eli: keep it short and optional. product wants it. round values to reduce noise.

sophie: testing checklist: VoiceOver/NVDA/ChromeVox announce as radio + checked state; focus visible at 200% zoom; arrow keys update tabindex and aria-checked; announce fires once per change.

aria-bot: queued a11y-lint for branch 'drawer/fix-radios'  a11y checks: roles, focus, contrast, aria-live.

devon: pushing WIP PR. i'll add unit tests for keyboard matrix.

maya: i'll review once PR lands. tagging @sophie to help with NVDA checks. :thumbsup:
